items.question: This stratification is significant across metrics. Split the reference curves by it, or keep them unstratified?
items.reviewer_rationale: Not applied under standing decision strat09-advisory-not-applied (policy 1.5): this candidate is a Broad-Use Candidate (5 of 19 metrics tested respond to it, consistency 0.558) and its smallest populated class holds 52 sites (classes 52/90/101), so the DATA-07 floor is not what stops it.
